notes: battleOnly compares the derived persistence with pokemon_forms.is_battle_only; mega with is_mega; default with is_default on the form and its pokemon.
entry applies to Mega, Primal, and Gigantamax forms, which PokeAPI names after the form they enter from. Other states carry no entry information in the snapshot.
unmatched lists forms PokeAPI does not know; their inherited facts are marked inherited:unsourced in the species file.
missingStateForms lists power-up forms PokeAPI has for app species and the app does not.

review.note: PokeAPI: Neutral Mode is the default form and Active Mode is battle-only. In X and Y, Xerneas is Neutral Mode outside battle and Active Mode in battle. App: the default form xerneas (sprite 716, the look every sprite set draws) is Active Mode, and Neutral Mode is a permanent form (app id 11000). Option a: keep; nothing users see changes. Option b: make Neutral Mode the default and Active Mode a battle-mode state; that swaps the Dex sprite for Xerneas (visible) and retires number 11000. Recommendation: a.

PokeAPI: each Core is its own pokemon with is_battle_only 0, and Meteor Form is the species default. In the games a Minior is in Meteor Form outside battle; the Core shows when Shields Down breaks the shell under half HP and the Pokemon returns to Meteor Form after the battle. The core color is a permanent, hidden property of each Minior. App: Meteor Form is the default and the seven Cores are battle-mode states, which the Picker lists and the Dex and League leave out as battle states. The alternative, seven permanent color forms with one shared Meteor look, would put seven identical Meteor rows in the tools. Recommendation: keep.

missingStateForms.note: PokeAPI names it after toxtricity-low-key; the app has no form for it.
PokeAPI names it after meowstic-female; the app has no form for it.

questions.question: Should the app add Mega Meowstic (female) as a form?
evidence: PokeAPI (mega-dimension version group) has meowstic-female-mega with the same stats and ability (Trace) as meowstic-male-mega, so female Meowstic Mega Evolves, into a form with its own look.
The app has one Mega Meowstic, entered from the male form only; it is listed under missingStateForms.
questions.recommendation: Add it as a new form when the Legends: Z-A DLC forms are added. No fact in the ontology changes until then.

questions.question: Gigantamax Toxtricity is one form entered from Amped and Low Key; whose abilities should it carry?
evidence: PokeAPI keeps two Gigantamax records: toxtricity-amped-gmax with Plus and toxtricity-low-key-gmax with Minus; the games keep each form's abilities when it Gigantamaxes.
The app has one form, so its abilities are Amped's (Punk Rock, Plus, Technician). Low Key's Gigantamax (Minus) is listed under missingStateForms.
questions.recommendation: Keep one form with Amped's abilities until phase 2 makes the catalogs projections; then split it into two forms, one per entry form.

questions.question: Can female Pyroar Mega Evolve?
evidence: PokeAPI has one pyroar-mega and no female Mega form, while it has both Meowstic Megas. So either female Pyroar cannot Mega Evolve, or Mega Pyroar has no gender difference. The snapshot cannot tell which.
The app enters Mega Pyroar from the male form only.
questions.recommendation: Keep the male-only entry until a game record settles it.

questions.question: What abilities do the four Terastal Ogerpon forms have?
evidence: The snapshot has no Terastal Ogerpon forms, so the app inherits each mask form's ability and marks it inherited:unsourced.
In Scarlet and Violet a Terastallized Ogerpon has Embody Aspect, one per mask.
questions.recommendation: Add a cited source for the four abilities (a game personal record or Bulbapedia) in a later phase; nothing shows abilities today.

questions.question: What abilities do the nine Legends: Z-A Megas that PokeAPI has no abilities for have?
evidence: At commit bc92d3b6 PokeAPI lists no ability for zygarde-mega, heatran-mega, darkrai-mega, magearna-mega, magearna-original-mega, zeraora-mega, and the three tatsugiri megas.
The app inherits each base form's abilities and marks them inherited:unsourced.
questions.recommendation: Refresh from a newer pinned PokeAPI commit, or a ZA personal record, when either has them.
